name: Jodie Allen
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 4)
description: The people I support often identify as LGBTIAQ+ and may be questioning around their gender. Many of my clients are also neurodivergent and/or have experienced various forms of trauma and family violence which I am passionate in working alongside kindly, gently and safely. I am also fiercely sex and sex-worker positive! I'm an experienced trauma-informed Alcohol & Other Drug (AOD) and Mental Health Counsellor with experience in Family Violence living and working on unceded Wurundjeri lands (so-called Melbourne, Australia). I can offer EMDR therapy, ACT, IFS/ego/parts work and Motivational Interviewing.

name: Josh Sasai
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 4)
description: Hi, I'm Josh, a Registered Counsellor and an Accredited Mental Health Social Worker. I specialise in helping clients with trauma (C/PTSD), anxiety, depression, and chronic conditions using Body-Mind Processing practices. I offer a range of therapeutic approaches tailored to individual needs, including EMDR Therapy, Brainspotting, Somatic Approach, Mindfulness, Focusing, Internal Family Systems, Clinical Hypnosis, Qigong, Havening Techniques, and Meridian Tapping. These methods are proven effective for stress reduction, emotion regulation, and trauma processing.
